title: Nanofactory Animation
summary: A short animation illustrating the proposed nanofactory concept, where nanomachines assemble atomically precise parts into larger products. It depicts how such a system might build macroscopic goods from raw materials and energy.
why: Shared as a visualization of Ralph Merkle's theoretical work on molecular manufacturing.

quote.text: Ralph Merkle (of public key cryptograpy fame) has done some recent theoretical work
